problem: After 6 hops, how far has a kangaroo toy travelled if every hop is 9 centimetres?
follow_up_questions: Its toy house is 80 centimetres from the start. How much farther must it hop?

problem: With help from 3 teachers, the art club picked out 14 colouring books. Each book has 45 pictures. How many pictures are there to colour?
follow_up_questions: The children have coloured 58 pictures so far. How many are left to colour?
They coloured 72 more on Friday. How many are still left?

problem: How many stickers are in the sticker books? Lena has 14 books with 45 stickers in each, and she got them for 3 birthdays.
follow_up_questions: She has already used 58 stickers. How many are left?
She uses 72 more at the weekend. How many stickers remain now?

problem: There are 25 school canteens in the town, and the bakery sends 36 rolls to every one of them. How many rolls does the bakery send?
How many crayons does the district order if each of its 25 classrooms gets 36 crayons?
At camp, the campers worked in 6 groups, and every group built 5 birdhouses from scrap wood. The roofs were painted green. How many birdhouses did they build?
follow_up_questions: Each birdhouse is filled with 3 scoops of seeds. How many scoops are needed?

problem: How many vases did the art class make? Each of 6 groups made 5 vases from clay. The kiln was very hot.
follow_up_questions: Each vase holds 3 paper flowers. How many paper flowers are needed?

problem: At practice, the dance group goes through each of its 7 dances twice. How many dances do they perform in all?
follow_up_questions: Each dance lasts 3 minutes. How many minutes of dancing is that?
Practice is 60 minutes long. How many minutes are left for other things?
That time is split into 3 equal rests. How long is each rest?

problem: How many times do the pupils read a poem aloud if there are 7 poems and they read each one twice?
follow_up_questions: Reading a poem takes 3 minutes. How many minutes of reading is that?
The lesson lasts 60 minutes. How much time is left over?
The leftover time is shared equally among 3 games. How many minutes does each game get?

problem: The parking lot opens 95 minutes before the match. It has 19 spaces in each of its 13 rows. How many parking spaces are there?
follow_up_questions: A bus company used 4 whole rows. How many spaces did it use?

problem: How many pots are in the greenhouse? There are 13 rows with 19 pots in every row, and the greenhouse is 95 steps from the house.
follow_up_questions: The gardener moves 4 whole rows outside. How many pots does she move?

problem: Tokens for the school fair come in strips of 5, and Noa sold 9 strips. The face painting stand had a long queue. How many tokens did Noa sell?
follow_up_questions: Her friend sold 3 fewer strips. How many tokens did her friend sell?
How many tokens did they sell between them?

problem: How many seed packets did Omar sell? He sold 9 boxes at the garden market, with 5 packets in every box. The market tents were striped green and white.
follow_up_questions: His brother sold 3 fewer boxes. How many packets did his brother sell?
What is the total number of packets the two boys sold?

problem: After the storm, 7 volunteers each cleared 4 garden paths of fallen leaves. How many paths were cleared?
follow_up_questions: Each path took 10 minutes. How many minutes of work was that?

problem: How many cars were washed at the charity car wash if 7 helpers each washed 4 cars?
follow_up_questions: Washing one car took 10 minutes. How many minutes of washing was that?

problem: Paper stars were the craft club's project this week: each of the 18 pupils made 15 of them. What is the total number of stars?
follow_up_questions: The stars were hung on ribbons, 9 to a ribbon. How many ribbons were used?
Each ribbon needs 2 pins. How many pins were needed?
The club had 75 pins. How many pins were not used?

problem: How many beads did the camp's bead group string, if 18 campers threaded 15 beads each?
follow_up_questions: The beads were then used to make bracelets of 9 beads each. How many bracelets were made?
Every bracelet needs 2 clasps. How many clasps were needed?
There were 75 clasps in the box. How many were left over?

problem: Every kite the club made for the festival on May 21 got 6 ribbon tails. If the club made 8 kites, how many tails did it tie on?
follow_up_questions: Tails come in packs of 12. How many packs were used?
On the windy hill, two kites lost all their tails. How many tails were still on kites?

problem: How many legs did the pupils glue on? For the bug display on 21 October, they made 8 paper beetles with 6 legs each.
follow_up_questions: The legs were cut from strips of 12. How many strips were used?
Two of the beetles lost all their legs on the way home. How many legs were still on beetles?

problem: Nine gardeners brought 3 pumpkins each to the flower show. What is the total number of pumpkins on display?
What is the total number of paintings on show if 9 artists each hang 3 paintings in the gallery?
Each of the 33 swimmers in the swim club got 27 lap cards for the season. The cards were laminated so they would not get soggy. How many lap cards were handed out?
follow_up_questions: Swimmers used 84 cards in the first week. How many have not been used yet?

problem: How many worksheets did the teacher copy? She made 27 for each of her 33 pupils. The copier was very loud.
follow_up_questions: The pupils finished 84 worksheets in the first month. How many are still not done?

problem: Four children shared each of the 6 picnic blankets in the park. How many children were at the picnic?
follow_up_questions: Each child ate 3 strawberries. How many strawberries were eaten?
A tub holds 24 strawberries. How many tubs did they open?

problem: How many dancers were on stage when they stood in 6 groups of 4?
follow_up_questions: Every dancer waved 3 ribbons. How many ribbons were there?
Ribbons are sold in packs of 24. How many packs were bought?

problem: A school orders 19 boxes of pencils, with 32 pencils in each box. How many pencils arrive?
follow_up_questions: Next term it orders 45 more pencils than that. How many pencils is that?

problem: How many letters did the post office sort if 19 workers each sorted 32 letters?
follow_up_questions: The next day, 45 more letters than that arrived. How many letters arrived the next day?

problem: The class read 4 stories in a 50-minute lesson, and every story was 7 pages long. What is the total number of pages they read?
follow_up_questions: After lunch they read 3 more stories with the same number of pages. How many pages did they read in all?
Each page has 4 pictures. How many pictures is that?
The class skipped 16 of the pictures. How many pictures did they look at?

problem: How many laps did the team swim? At the 50-metre pool, 4 swimmers each swam 7 laps.
follow_up_questions: Then 3 more swimmers each swam the same number of laps. How many laps were swum in all?
Each lap counts for 4 points. How many points is that?
The judge took away 16 points for false starts. How many points did the team keep?

problem: A fruit seller fills 3 baskets, putting 9 oranges into every basket. How many oranges does he have for sale?
How many cups of lemonade are on the table if there are 3 jugs and each jug fills 9 cups?
Adaeze walks along the stepping-stone path 4 times. There are 10 stones on the path. How many times does she step on a stone?
follow_up_questions: Her cousin walks along it 3 times. How many times does her cousin step on a stone?
How many more steps on stones did Adaeze take than her cousin?

problem: How many steps does Luca climb if the staircase has 10 steps and he goes up it 4 times?
follow_up_questions: His sister goes up it 3 times. How many steps does she climb?
How many more steps did Luca climb than his sister?

problem: Farida's class brought 5 bottles of juice to the party, and each bottle fills 6 glasses. How many glasses of juice can they pour?
follow_up_questions: They poured 18 glasses during the games. How many glasses of juice are left to pour?

problem: What was the total amount of rice, in cups, if the camp cook had 5 bags and each held 6 cups?
follow_up_questions: She cooked 18 cups for dinner. How many cups of rice are left?

problem: Helpers at the library's book swap load 8 boxes of books onto each of 6 carts so visitors can browse easily. How many boxes are on the carts?
follow_up_questions: By lunchtime, 29 boxes have been emptied. How many boxes are still full?

problem: How many plants are on the shelves of the garden centre's spring sale? Staff have arranged 6 shelves, each holding 8 plants, so shoppers can walk past them all.
follow_up_questions: By noon, 29 plants have been sold. How many are still on the shelves?

problem: On the first day of school, Mr Abara opens a box in the classroom. It contains 7 packs of pencils with 24 pencils in each pack. How many pencils are in the box?
follow_up_questions: He hands out 58 pencils in the morning. How many pencils does he have left?
In the afternoon, 5 more packs of the same kind arrive. How many pencils does he have now?

problem: How many beads did the craft shop get? A parcel came this morning holding 7 strings, each with 24 beads.
follow_up_questions: The shop sells 58 beads before closing. How many beads are left?
The next day 5 more strings like those arrive. How many beads does the shop have now?

problem: The school photographer wants no messy hair on picture day, so she puts 5 combs in each of 7 boxes. Already 12 classes are lining up in the hall. How many combs are in the boxes?
follow_up_questions: By lunch, 18 combs have been handed out. How many combs are left?

problem: How many paintbrushes are on the tables? In the art room, where 12 children are already waiting, Ms Ruiz has put out 7 jars with 5 brushes in each.
follow_up_questions: During the lesson, 18 brushes get too messy to use. How many clean brushes are left?

problem: Lifeguards always keep spare swim goggles at the pool. There are 9 baskets by the pool, each with 4 pairs inside. How many pairs of goggles are there?
How many spare rackets does the tennis club keep? Each of its 9 cupboards holds 4 rackets, ready for anyone who forgets theirs.
A lorry brings paving slabs to the park for a new path. It drops off 6 stacks, and each stack has 45 slabs. How many slabs arrived?
follow_up_questions: On Monday, workers lay 85 slabs. How many have not been laid yet?
On Tuesday they lay 3 rows of 40 slabs. How many slabs are left after that?
The leftover slabs are piled up in stacks of 5 by the gate. How many stacks are there?

problem: How many tiles were delivered to the swimming pool? The van brought 6 boxes of tiles, with 45 in every box.
follow_up_questions: The tilers fixed 85 tiles on the first day. How many tiles are still in the boxes?
The next day they fixed 3 rows of 40 tiles. How many tiles are left now?
The spare tiles are stored in piles of 5. How many piles are there?

problem: There are 9 tables at Ingrid's stall for the summer fair, and she ties 4 balloons to every table to make it look bright. Her dog sleeps under the biggest table. How many balloons does she tie on?
follow_up_questions: Balloons come in bags of 6. How many bags does she use?
Each bag cost 7 dollars. How much did she spend on balloons?

problem: How many coat hooks does the coach screw into the walls? The changing room gets 4 hooks above each of its 9 benches before the season starts. The room smells of fresh paint.
follow_up_questions: Hooks are sold in packs of 6. How many packs did the coach open?
A pack costs 7 dollars. How much did the coach pay for the hooks?

problem: Grandpa is making fruit baskets for the neighbours before the holiday. He has packed 7 baskets so far, and each basket holds 6 pears. How many pears has he used?
follow_up_questions: He wants to make 3 more baskets just like these. How many more pears does he need?

problem: How many candles has Lucia used? She is getting ready for a party and has decorated 7 cakes, putting 6 candles on each.
follow_up_questions: Her mum asks for 3 more cakes like these. How many more candles will Lucia need?

problem: To welcome visitors at the entrance, a farmer sets out apples in 8 rows with 14 apples in each row. Her orchard has been open for 5 years. How many apples are in the display?
follow_up_questions: Visitors buy 47 of the display apples. How many are left?
She packs the rest into bags of 5. How many bags does she fill?

problem: How many melons are in the stall's display? The stall has been in the market for 5 years, and today the owner has arranged 14 melons in each of 8 rows.
follow_up_questions: Shoppers buy 47 melons by noon. How many melons remain?
The owner packs the rest into boxes of 5. How many boxes does she fill?

problem: Nine children had a go at the beanbag game on school fun day, and each player threw 3 beanbags. How many beanbags were thrown in all?
How many darts were thrown at the fair on Sunday if 9 grown-ups each paid for a turn of 3 darts?
For the swimming gala relay, Coach Silva splits the club into 5 teams, with 4 swimmers in each team. How many swimmers take part?
follow_up_questions: After the race, every swimmer gets 2 juice boxes. How many juice boxes does the coach hand out?

problem: How many dancers take part in the school show if Ms Kim makes 5 groups with 4 dancers in each?
follow_up_questions: Each dancer wears 2 ribbons. How many ribbons does Ms Kim need?

problem: A mosaic for the school entrance is being made by the art club. Every one of its 8 members paints 6 tiles. How many tiles will be in the mosaic?
follow_up_questions: The tiles are set in rows of 8. How many rows does the mosaic have?
Each row gets 3 shiny stones along its edge. How many stones is that?
Stones are sold in bags of 6. How many bags must the club buy?

problem: How many patches will the class banner have? Every one of the 8 children in the group decorates 6 patches for it.
follow_up_questions: The patches are sewn in rows of 8. How many rows will the banner have?
There are 3 bells hung at the end of each row. How many bells is that?
Bells come in packets of 6. How many packets does the class need?

problem: Mei built a sandcastle on the beach using 12 levels, with 9 buckets of sand in each level. A seagull watched her from a rock. How many buckets of sand did she use?
follow_up_questions: Then Mei adds a tower made from 15 more buckets. What is the total number of buckets now?

problem: How many cups did Ali stack? His tower of paper cups has 12 layers with 9 cups in each layer. Ali's favourite cups are the striped ones.
follow_up_questions: He finishes it with a top made of 15 more cups. How many cups are in the tower now?

problem: It's match night, so the pizza shop sends out 8 drivers with 7 pizzas each. How many pizzas are being delivered?
How many newspapers does Javier drop off? On each of the 8 roads in his village, he leaves 7 papers every morning.
The librarian is ordering bookmarks for Reading Week, when every child who borrows a book gets one free. She buys 16 packs of 6 bookmarks. How many bookmarks is that?
follow_up_questions: By Friday, 58 bookmarks have been handed out. How many are left for next week?

problem: How many water bottles does the coach order for the summer camp? He orders 16 crates, and each crate holds 6 bottles.
follow_up_questions: In the first week, 58 bottles are given out. How many are left?

problem: Painters are working on the new school. It has 5 hallways, and each hallway has 6 doors to paint. Find the number of doors they must paint.
follow_up_questions: So far 13 doors have been painted. How many still need painting?

problem: How many lights does the electrician need for the new car park? It has 5 levels with 6 lights on every level.
follow_up_questions: She has put up 13 lights so far. How many still have to go up?

problem: Bella orders 6 boxes of cones for her ice cream van, with 15 cones in each box. She orders early because the delivery takes 3 days. How many cones is she ordering?
follow_up_questions: She stacks the cones in towers of 9. How many towers does she make?
In the first week she sells 27 cones. How many cones are left?
Each cone sells for 4 dollars. How much money will she get if she sells all the cones that are left?

problem: How many seed packets is the garden shop ordering? The owner, who opens the shop 3 days a week, asks for 6 boxes with 15 packets in every box.
follow_up_questions: She pins the packets on boards, 9 to a board. How many boards does she use?
In the first week she sells 27 packets. How many are left?
A packet costs 4 dollars. How much money will she make by selling all the packets that are left?

problem: For a birthday party in the park, Kenzo is topping 6 cakes with strawberries. Every cake gets 5 strawberries. The party guests will sit on picnic blankets. How many strawberries does he use?
How many balloons does Priya need? She is decorating 6 tables at the library for a book party, and 5 balloons go on each table. The library has a red front door.
A scout group of 8 children visited the orchard on Thursday, and each child picked 3 apples to take home. How many apples did the scouts bring back?
follow_up_questions: On the way home, 5 of the apples got bruised and were thrown away. How many apples were left?
At the scout hut, the leader adds 11 apples from her own tree. How many apples are in the fruit bowl now?

problem: How many shells did the swimming class bring home from the beach? Each of the 8 children was allowed to keep 3 shells.
follow_up_questions: On the bus, 5 shells cracked. How many shells are still whole?
Back at school, the teacher adds 11 shells from her own collection. How many shells are on the nature table now?

problem: Each of the 4 judges at the school talent show writes one comment card for every act. There are 8 acts. How many comment cards are written?
follow_up_questions: Next year there will be 2 more judges and the same number of acts. How many comment cards will be written then?

problem: How many cups of soup get tasted at the cook-off? There are 8 soups, and each of the 4 judges tastes one cup of every soup.
follow_up_questions: Next time, 2 more judges join and the number of soups stays the same. How many cups will be tasted?

problem: Each of the 23 divers at the swimming gala gets 3 dives, and the diving board must be checked after every dive. How many checks are needed?
follow_up_questions: A coach does 17 of the checks, and a lifeguard does the rest. How many checks does the lifeguard do?
Each check takes the lifeguard 2 minutes. How many minutes does she spend checking?

problem: How many times does the bowling machine reset the pins? At the bowling party, each of 23 children bowls 3 times, and the pins reset after every throw.
follow_up_questions: The machine does 17 of the resets on its own, and a worker does the rest by hand. How many resets does the worker do?
Each reset takes the worker 2 minutes. How many minutes is that?

problem: Seven backpacks were finished this week by the craft group that meets in hall 14 on Tuesdays. Each backpack has 3 zips. How many zips did they sew in?
follow_up_questions: Every zip gets 2 little pull tabs. How many pull tabs do they need?

problem: How many pockets does the tailor sew? In her shop at number 14 on the high street, she makes 7 coats, and each coat has 3 pockets.
follow_up_questions: She adds 2 buttons to each pocket. How many buttons does she need?

problem: To stop the goats getting into the vegetable patch, Farmer Ruth stacks hay bales in a wall 5 rows high and 9 bales long. How many bales did she use?
How many books are in Jun's book wall? He piled them across the doorway 9 books long and 5 rows high to stop his toy cars rolling out.
The community kitchen got 14 boxes of eggs from a nearby farm, with 6 eggs in every box. The hens had been laying well all spring. How many eggs did the kitchen get?
follow_up_questions: The cook puts the eggs into bowls of 4. How many bowls can she fill?
By dinner, 15 bowls have been used. How many bowls are left?
The leftover bowls are split evenly between 2 cooks. How many bowls does each cook get?

problem: How many apples did the school canteen get? The orchard sent 14 crates, and every crate held 6 apples. The crates smelled sweet.
follow_up_questions: The canteen puts the apples into bags of 4. How many bags can be filled?
At lunch, 15 bags were handed out. How many bags are left?
The bags that are left are shared evenly between 2 classes. How many bags does each class get?

problem: The 9 swimmers in Coach Bianca's team want 3 postcards each to send to their pen pals. How many postcards do they buy at the shop?
follow_up_questions: Each postcard needs one stamp, and stamps come in books of 9. How many books of stamps do they buy?
One book of stamps costs 8 dollars. How much do they pay for the stamps?

problem: How many letters does the reading club send to the author? Each of its 9 members writes 3 letters.
follow_up_questions: Envelopes are sold in packs of 9, and every letter gets its own envelope. How many packs are needed?
A pack costs 8 dollars. How much do the envelopes cost?

problem: Before the spelling bee, Mr Lund puts up word lists in the hall. There are 4 posters, and each poster has 8 lines of words. How many lines of words are there in all?
follow_up_questions: One boy reads every line on 3 of the posters. How many lines did he read?

problem: How many shelves does the bookshop have if 4 bookcases stand along the wall with 8 shelves in each?
follow_up_questions: A helper dusts every shelf in 3 of the bookcases. How many shelves does she dust?

problem: The sailing club needed new ropes, so Captain Fiona, a sailor for 18 years, bought 6 of them. Each rope is 25 metres long. What is the total length of the new ropes, in metres?
follow_up_questions: The sailors unroll 4 of the ropes to check them. How many metres of rope are unrolled?
How many metres of the new rope are still coiled up?

problem: How many metres of ribbon did the craft shop buy? It got 6 rolls of ribbon, each 25 metres long, from a supplier that is 18 kilometres away.
follow_up_questions: The shop cuts up 4 of the rolls for a wedding. How many metres of ribbon is that?
How many metres of the new ribbon are still on rolls?

problem: At the skating rink, 5 shelves hold spare skates, and each shelf has 6 pairs. How many pairs of spare skates are there?
How many life jackets are stored at the boat hire? They hang in 5 lockers, with 6 jackets in each.
Rahim is mending 7 wobbly stools at the furniture shop. Each stool has 3 legs, and he puts a new rubber foot on every leg. How many rubber feet does he use?
follow_up_questions: Each rubber foot costs 5 dollars. What did the new feet cost altogether?

problem: How many lids does the kitchen need? The cook is making 7 big lunch trays, and every tray holds 3 pots that each need a lid.
follow_up_questions: A lid costs 5 dollars. How much do all the lids cost?

problem: The bakery is preparing treats for a wedding party. Every one of the 8 guest tables will get a plate of 4 cupcakes. The wedding is in a big white tent. How many cupcakes does the baker need?
follow_up_questions: She already has 20 cupcakes in the fridge. How many more must she bake?
Her oven bakes cupcakes in trays of 3. How many trays does she bake?
If each tray costs 6 dollars to bake, how much does the baking cost?

problem: How many name cards does the class need? For the parents' evening, there are 8 tables, and 4 name cards go on each. The hall smells of fresh flowers.
follow_up_questions: The teacher has already written 20 cards. How many more must she write?
Blank cards come in packs of 3. How many packs does she open?
If each pack costs 6 dollars, how much does she spend on them?

problem: Sione is hanging fairy lights for the evening fair in the school garden. He puts 16 lights on each of the 5 fences. What is the total number of lights?
follow_up_questions: Each light needs 3 batteries. How many batteries is that?

problem: How many torches does the camp need for the night walk? There are 5 groups of hikers, and each group gets 16 torches.
follow_up_questions: A torch uses 3 batteries. How many batteries do the torches use?

problem: Children at the town zoo love the rabbit corner, where 5 rabbits live in each of 6 hutches. The zoo has 26 kinds of animals in all. How many rabbits are in the rabbit corner?
follow_up_questions: In the evening each rabbit gets 2 lettuce leaves. How many leaves are eaten?
The keeper brought 75 lettuce leaves that day. How many leaves are left over?

problem: How many hens live in the farm's coops? There are 6 coops with 5 hens in each, and the farm also has 26 apple trees.
follow_up_questions: Each hen is given 2 scoops of grain. How many scoops is that?
The farmer filled 75 scoops of grain that morning. How many scoops are left?

problem: At the beach party, 4 teams of 7 sign up for the sandcastle contest. Work out how many people are building sandcastles.
How many rowers are on the river if 4 boats race and each boat carries 7 rowers?
Paper chains will decorate the hall for the spring concert. The art class makes 5 chains with 18 links on each. Find the number of links.
follow_up_questions: They also cut 6 spare links in case some tear. How many links did they make in all?

problem: How many lanterns hang over the street market? Volunteers string up 5 lines with 18 lanterns on each line.
follow_up_questions: They keep 6 extra lanterns in a box in case some break. How many lanterns are there in all?

problem: Using a kit from Aunt Rosa, the children built a doll hotel. Each of its 4 floors has beds for 9 dolls. How many dolls can sleep in the hotel?
follow_up_questions: The children have only 28 dolls. How many beds stay empty?
Then a friend brings 5 more dolls to stay. How many beds are empty now?

problem: How many boats can tie up at the marina? It has 4 jetties, and each jetty has space for 9 boats.
follow_up_questions: Today 28 boats are tied up. How many spaces are free?
Later, 5 more boats come in. How many spaces are free now?

problem: For its spring giveaway, the community centre packed 3 seed packets into each of 9 boxes. A local garden shop gave the seeds. How many seed packets are in the boxes?
follow_up_questions: On the first day, 4 boxes are given away. How many seed packets are still in boxes?

problem: How many scarves are in the parcels? Before winter, the shelter wrapped 9 parcels, with 3 scarves in each. A group of students knitted the scarves.
follow_up_questions: On Monday, 4 parcels are handed out. How many scarves are still in parcels?

problem: Opening at 9 each morning, the swimming pool lets swimmers hire lockers. Its locker wall has 12 lockers in each of 8 rows. How many lockers are there?
follow_up_questions: All but 15 of the lockers are hired. How many lockers are hired?
Next month, 7 of the free lockers are hired too. How many lockers are free now?
The manager then adds 2 new rows of 12 lockers. How many free lockers are there after that?

problem: How many cubbyholes are in the school hallway? The cubbyholes stand in 8 rows of 12, and the school bell rings at 9.
follow_up_questions: All but 15 of the cubbyholes have a name on them. How many have a name?
Then 7 new pupils get names on free cubbyholes. How many cubbyholes are without a name now?
The caretaker builds 2 new rows of 12 cubbyholes. How many cubbyholes are without a name after that?

problem: In the reading corner of Ms Okoro's class there are 7 comics in each of the 4 boxes beside the beanbags. What is the number of comics the children can pick from?
How many toys are in the dentist's playroom? The nurse has put out 4 tubs, and each tub holds 7 toys.
A picture frame has 4 sides, and Lars glues 9 shells along each side. How many shells does he glue?
follow_up_questions: He paints 2 dots on every shell. How many dots does he paint?

problem: How many flags line the running track? The track has 4 straight parts, and 9 flags are put along each part.
follow_up_questions: Each flag is tied on with 2 strings. How many strings are used?

problem: Mr Varga restrings 14 ukuleles on Thursday so they are ready for the music school's concert. Each ukulele needs 4 new strings. How many strings does he use?
follow_up_questions: He started the day with 72 strings. How many does he have left?
On Friday morning he uses the rest on more ukuleles, giving each one the same number of strings as before. How many ukuleles does he restring on Friday?

problem: How many wheels does the skate shop fit? Before the race on Sunday, Rania puts new wheels on 14 skateboards, 4 wheels per board.
follow_up_questions: The shop had 72 wheels that morning. How many wheels are left?
She uses the leftover wheels on more skateboards, giving each the same number as before. How many more skateboards get new wheels?

problem: Ivo fills 8 fruit cups with 5 grapes in each for the bakery, which is 3 doors down from his stall. How many grapes does he use?
follow_up_questions: The bakery then wants 2 extra cups of the same size. How many grapes does Ivo use in all?

problem: How many beads does Sana need? She is making 8 bracelets with 5 beads each for a shop that sits 3 blocks from her house.
follow_up_questions: The shop asks for 2 more bracelets like those. How many beads does she use altogether?

problem: Seven paper bags at the fruit stall were filled with the last oranges of the day, 6 oranges per bag. Each bag had a smiling sun printed on it. How many oranges were bagged?
How many muffins did the baker box up? She packed 6 muffins into each of 7 boxes for the school fair. The boxes were tied with yellow string.
On the last roller coaster ride of the day, all 16 carts are full, with 4 riders in each cart. How many people are on the ride?
follow_up_questions: Each rider gives 3 tokens. How many tokens is that?
The worker stacks the tokens in piles of 8. How many piles does he make?
He puts 2 piles into each bag. How many bags does he need?

problem: How many campers can sleep in the cabins if there are 16 cabins with 4 beds in each, and every bed is taken?
follow_up_questions: Each camper brings 3 blankets. How many blankets is that?
The blankets are folded into stacks of 8. How many stacks are there?
Each shelf holds 2 stacks. How many shelves are needed?

problem: Tobias has 4 days left before the science fair. His craft-stick bridge has 23 sticks in each of its 6 sections. How many sticks has he used for the sections?
follow_up_questions: The railings use 35 more sticks. How many sticks are in the whole bridge?
His sticks came in 2 bags of 95. How many sticks did he not use?

problem: How many bricks are in the walls of the dollhouse? Nia has 4 days to finish it for her cousin, and so far she has built 6 walls with 23 bricks in each.
follow_up_questions: The roof takes 35 more bricks. How many bricks are in the whole dollhouse?
Her brick set came in 2 tubs of 95 bricks. How many bricks are left over?

problem: By tea time on Sunday, library volunteers had filled 8 boxes for the book sale. Each box held exactly 6 books. What is the total number of books they packed?
How many jars of jam did the helpers pack at the farm shop? They filled 8 trays, and every tray takes 6 jars.
After each lesson, swimming coach Dana hands out gold star stickers. One card of stars has 6 rows with 4 stars in a row. How many stars are on a card?
follow_up_questions: Dana uses 3 full cards in one morning. How many stars is that?

problem: How many sandbags line the river bank? Workers have built 6 piles, each 5 sandbags high.

How many sandbags are still in piles?

problem: Tavita's family picked plums from their orchard for the school kitchen: 4 buckets, each holding 9 plums. How many plums did the kitchen get?

problem: How many eggs did Grandma's hens lay this week? She collected 4 baskets, and each basket had 9 eggs.
follow_up_questions: She gives the eggs away in cartons of 6. How many cartons does she fill?

problem: Every day, 19 pupils ride on each of the school bus's 5 trips to the swimming pool. The bus has soft blue seats. How many pupils ride the bus in a day?
